name: L1 · 我们去机场接你们
titleEn: We will pick you up at the airport

intro.cn: 在家里，刘明和王一雪在沙发上聊天儿。
intro.en: At home, Liu Ming and Wang Yixue were chatting on the sofa.

questions.q: 刘明和王一雪在做什么？
刘明跟王一雪一起去机场做什么？

lines.speaker: 刘明
lines.cn: 这是杨同乐吗？他怎么跟白家月在一起？
lines.en: Is that Yang Tongle? Why is he with Bai Jiayue?

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.cn: 他不是杨同乐，他叫李文，是白家月的好朋友。
lines.en: That's not Yang Tongle. That's Li Wen. He's a good friend of Bai Jiayue.

lines.speaker: 刘明
lines.cn: 我还以为是同乐呢，他们看上去有点儿像。
lines.en: Oh, I thought it was Tongle. They do look a bit alike.

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.cn: 是长得有点儿像，但是他比同乐高，身高有一米八。
lines.en: Yes, they look somewhat alike, but he's taller than Tongle—about 1.8 meters.

lines.speaker: 刘明
lines.cn: 看起来也比同乐瘦一点儿。
lines.en: And he looks a bit thinner, too.

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.cn: 下个星期家月和李文要来北京，我去机场接他们。
lines.en: Jiayue and Li Wen are coming to Beijing next week. I'm going to pick them up at the airport.

lines.speaker: 刘明
lines.cn: 他们哪天到北京？我跟你一起去机场接他们吧。
lines.en: What day will they get here? I'll come with you to pick them up.

postQuestions.q: 刘明为什么以为李文是杨同乐？
白家月什么时候来中国？

intro.cn: 在机场，李文和白家月在行李领取处。
intro.en: At the airport, Li Wen and Bai Jiayue were at baggage claim.

questions.q: 李文和白家月在机场做什么？

lines.speaker: 白家月
lines.cn: 我的行李怎么还没出来？是不是丢了？
lines.en: Why hasn't my luggage shown up yet? Could it be lost?

lines.speaker: 李文
lines.cn: 你的行李箱是什么样的？
lines.en: What does your suitcase look like?

lines.speaker: 白家月
lines.cn: 是一个黑色的箱子，上面写着我的名字和电话号码。
lines.en: It's a black one with my name and phone number on it.

lines.speaker: 李文
lines.cn: 我好像在哪儿看到过这个箱子，是不是有人拿错了？
lines.en: It seems I've seen one like that somewhere. Could someone have taken it by mistake?

lines.speaker: 白家月
lines.cn: 我们快找谁问一下吧，箱子里有不少重要的东西。
lines.en: Let's quickly find someone to ask. There are quite a few important things in it.

lines.speaker: 李文
lines.cn: 别着急，我们拿着护照和机票，去服务台问问吧。
lines.en: Don't worry. Let's take our passports and plane tickets to the service desk and ask there.

postQuestions.q: 白家月的箱子是什么样的？
李文看到过白家月的箱子吗？

intro.cn: 在机场大厅，刘明和王一雪接机。
intro.en: In the airport arrival hall, Liu Ming and Wang Yixue were waiting to meet their friends.

questions.q: 刘明和王一雪在机场做什么？
刘明为什么要站到中间？

lines.speaker: 刘明
lines.cn: 飞机早就到了，你看见白家月他们了吗？
lines.en: The plane arrived a while ago. Have you seen Bai Jiayue and Li Wen?

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.cn: 没有，他们应该快出来了。
lines.en: No, they should be coming out any minute now.

lines.speaker: 刘明
lines.cn: 我们站到中间去吧，这样他们好找一些。
lines.en: Let's stand in the middle so it'll be easier for them to spot us.

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.cn: 你看那个高个子的人是李文吗？
lines.en: Look, is that tall guy Li Wen?

lines.speaker: 刘明
lines.cn: 你说的是哪个？那个穿着黑衣服的短头发的年轻人？
lines.en: Which one do you mean? The young man with short hair, wearing black?

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.cn: 对，那个人就是李文！你看，家月在他后面呢。
lines.en: Yes, that's Li Wen! And look, Jiayue is right behind him.

postQuestions.q: 王一雪为什么说白家月他们应该快出来了？
刘明看见的年轻人长什么样？
王一雪怎么知道那个年轻人就是李文？

intro.cn: 在宾馆房间，李文在写日记。
intro.en: In the hotel room, Li Wen was writing in his diary.

questions.q: 李文回北京的路上花了多长时间？
李文觉得王老师的姐姐看起来怎么样？

lines.cn: 昨天我到北京了。
lines.en: Yesterday I arrived in Beijing.

lines.cn: 虽然路上花了十几个小时，但是跟家月坐在一起，我觉得时间过得很快。
lines.en: Though the journey took more than ten hours, sitting next to Jiayue made the time pass quickly.

lines.cn: 到机场的时候，家月发现行李箱不见了，我带她去服务台，帮助她找到了行李箱。
lines.en: When we arrived at the airport, Jiayue found her suitcase missing. So I took her to the service desk and helped her retrieve it.

lines.cn: 走出机场的时候，已经八点多了，我们一出来就看见了王老师的姐姐，她看起来比照片上年轻。
lines.en: By the time we left the airport, it was already past 8 p.m. As soon as we stepped outside, we saw Ms. Wang's cousin, who looked younger than in her photos.

lines.cn: 晚上，一雪姐带我们去吃了一家很好吃的中国菜。
lines.en: In the evening, Yixue took us to a Chinese restaurant with amazing food.

postQuestions.q: 李文为什么觉得时间过得很快？
到机场的时候，白家月发现了什么问题？
王一雪带他们去做什么了？

grammar.cn: 固定短语“看上去/看起来”
grammar.note: 固定短语“看上去”与“看起来”，可用来描述某人或某物的外观或状态。
grammar.noteEn: The set phrases “看上去” and “看起来” can be used to describe the appearance or condition of a person or an object.

items.c: 这些菜看起来都很好吃。
那个新来的老师看上去很年轻。
items.en: That new teacher looks very young.

grammar.cn: 疑问代词的非疑问用法（1）
grammar.note: 疑问代词“哪儿、什么、谁、哪”等用在陈述句中，表示不知道或不需要指明的地点、事物或人等。
grammar.noteEn: Interrogative pronouns such as “哪儿”, “什么”, “谁”, and “哪” can be used in declarative sentences to indicate unspecified places, things, or people.

items.c: 我好像在哪儿看到过这个箱子。
items.en: It seems I've seen this suitcase somewhere.
Have something to eat before you go.

items.c: 我们哪天一起去踢足球吧。
items.en: Let's go play football together one of these days.

practice.cn: A：你有时间了来我家，我______给你吃。（什么）
A：这几天太累了，我想______。（哪儿）

grammar.note: 名词性中心语的前面可以同时有多个定语，这些定语一般按照时间/处所、动作/状态、特点的顺序进行排列，数量短语或指量短语位置比较灵活，可以放在表示动作或状态的定语的前面或者后面。
grammar.noteEn: A nominal head can be modified by multiple attributives simultaneously. They are generally arranged in the order of time/location, action/state, and characteristic. The position of numeral-measure word phrases or demonstrative-measure word phrases is relatively flexible; they can be placed either before or after the attributive indicating an action or state.

items.en: The two people who went to see a film with Jiayue yesterday are my friends.
